stories.headline: Hong Kong — seven-week 'Tailbacker' crackdown nets 321 arrests and 231 kilos of cocaine and ketamine
stories.summary: Hong Kong police wrapped up "Operation Tailbacker," a citywide crackdown running from July 12 to August 29, with 321 arrests ranging in age from 13 to 72 across 234 drug cases.
